mentions.name: LemonLink
mentions.description: This tool generates a shareable link for any URL that shows whether the link was opened by a human or by an AI agent, and when it was opened.
mentions.problem: There weren't any good tools to show whether generic shared links like pitch decks, demos, articles, or videos were actually opened, or whether they were opened by a person or by AI.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built LemonLink to get a shareable link for any url that shows whether a human or AI opened it and when.
